chunks: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with a complete devotion.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to 'devote yourself exclusively' to God in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tawhid al-Af'al* (Oneness of Actions), urging the believer to detach from worldly distractions and focus solely on divine servitude. The command to 'devote yourself exclusively' (*Tabattal*) reflects the spiritual state of the Imams, who serve as perfect models of total concentration (*Khushu*) in worship and governance. This verse underscores the necessity of purifying the heart from all except God, a core tenet of Shia spiritual practice.
